name: lingoleap-firebase-cli
description: Pinned Firebase CLI for deploy.yml / staging-deploy.yml's deploy-frontend-firebase job. Claude Security find_01YP72Td7XmwD2J4TU5nTMgd (CRITICAL) / find_01GSz5fbgsPuuK3ieTGopD8B (HIGH): a plain `npm install -g firebase-tools@13` resolves a floating range at run time with no version or integrity recorded anywhere, then runs with a live GCP credential. This package.json + its committed package-lock.json pin the exact version and the full dependency tree's integrity hashes, so a newly published firebase-tools release (or a compromised transitive dependency) can't change what the credentialed deploy step executes without a reviewed repository change. Installed in CI with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` (verified locally: firebase-tools needs no install-time lifecycle scripts to run `firebase deploy --only hosting:*`). Issue #3947: bumped 13.35.1 -> 15.35.0 to clear 27 Dependabot alerts (1 critical/9 high tar + basic-ftp, 17 medium). `overrides` pins 5 deep transitive packages (glob/minimatch/re2/uuid/@opentelemetry/core) that firebase-tools' own package.json ranges don't let float far enough on their own -- verified `npm audit` -> 0 vulnerabilities and `firebase --version`/`firebase deploy --help` still load cleanly through the overridden tree.
